title: Bob Dylan comes knockin’ on pope’s door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican - NBC News
description: Leo had quoted from an unpublished protest song Dylan penned in 1963, “Go Away You Bomb,” in his 2026 book.

title: Wembanyama has career night with 52 points, 24 rebounds, 8 blocks in Spurs' win - ESPN
description: Victor Wembanyama had career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds along with eight blocks to power the Spurs past the Mavericks on Wednesday night.

title: Stock futures mixed after big rally following Democrats' decisive midterm wins - CNBC
description: The Dow Industrials posted its best day since April 2025, surging 3% after Democrats decisively swept Congress and oil prices fell.

title: Pennsylvania reports 6th measles-associated death - The Washington Post
description: A 21-year-old unvaccinated woman died after post-partum complications, funeral director said.

title: 2 Native American women make history in 2026 midterm elections - CBS News
description: In New Mexico, former Interior Secretary Deb Haaland was elected governor, making her the first Native American woman elected to lead a U.S. state. In Minnesota, Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan became the first Native American woman senator.
